title: Terrain workshop — mountains, erosion and painted trees
goal: Place a mountain, try different noise and water/wind erosion settings, then paint fir trees onto it. Compare lush grass, sparse soil patches and exposed stone. Raise/Lower, tunnels and grenades remain available.
changes: Open Mountains / erosion / tree painting. Mountain infill places ONE seeded feature; select an existing mountain and Apply settings to replace it. Water transports sediment downhill; directional wind redistributes exposed slopes on a small deterministic grid. This is stylised erosion, not a full hydrology model. Tree painting shares Save/Undo, uses fir LOD batches and waits for finished collision before grounding. New 1K CC0 PBR sets add irregular lush/sparse ground and weathered stone. Existing saved terrain is not replaced.
controls:
Mountain infill: arm button, then one terrain click. Configure radius, height, seed, noise, wavelength, octaves, erosion strengths/iterations and wind heading. To revise: select mountain, adjust, Apply.
Trees: Paint fir trees, hold LMB; main radius controls size. Density, height, slope and seed have labelled settings. Erase removes overlapping painted patches. Save explicitly. Undo restores edits. 600 resident painted-tree cap.
Raise/Lower: hold LMB. RMB + WASD fly; Space/Ctrl rise/fall. Wheel zoom; Shift-wheel size. F1 play/edit with readiness progress. B in play throws grenades. F8 log markers; F3 chunks; F2 briefing.
